2607.07196.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
2607.07196.paper_summary: Across robotics, World Models (WMs) are increasingly used to evaluate action policies by simulating the consequences of actions in an imagined world, and returning a success or safety verdict. Yet a verdict is only as trustworthy as the WM that produced it, and the WM itself needs to be certified. In video-generation WMs, fidelity metrics such as Fréchet Video Distance (FVD) reward visual realism, but ignore whether the world responds correctly to the policy's actions, including those unseen in training. Classical simulation-based validation assumes a trusted simulator evaluating an untrusted policy, whereas generative WMs are themselves unverified learned artifacts. Hence, we argue that any WM used as a test oracle must first be accredited before its verdicts can serve as evidence. Building on credibility practices from safety-critical simulation, including Verification, Validation & Accreditation (VV&A), Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF), and scenario-based testing standards, we define an admissibility ladder (L0-L4) that a WM must climb before its closed-loop verdicts are accepted as assurance evidence. Our framework is embodiment-agnostic, and is instantiated in autonomous driving (AD), where assurance methods for traditional simulation are most mature. Applied to two driving WMs, the lower rungs reveal a reversal: the model that ranks higher on visual generation quality (L0) ranks lower on action-following (L1-L2), so visual fidelity does not predict the action-robustness a closed-loop verdict depends on.
2607.07196.paper_summary_zh: 在機器人技術中，世界模型（WMs）越來越多地用於通過模擬行動在想像中的世界中的後果來評估行動政策，並返回成功或安全的判決。然而，判決的可信度僅與產生它的WM一樣可靠，而WM本身也需要被認證。在視頻生成的WM中，像Fréchet視頻距離（FVD）這樣的保真度指標獎勵視覺現實主義，但忽略了世界是否正確地對政策的行動做出反應，包括那些在訓練中未見的行動。傳統的基於模擬的驗證假設一個可信的模擬器在評估一個不可信的政策，而生成的WM本身則是未經驗證的學習產物。因此，我們主張，任何用作測試Oracle的WM必須首先獲得認證，然後它的判決才能作為證據。基於安全關鍵模擬的可信性實踐，包括驗證、驗證與認證（VV&A）、預期功能的安全性（SOTIF）和基於場景的測試標準，我們定義了一個可接受性階梯（L0-L4），WM必須在接受其閉環判決作為保證證據之前攀登這個階梯。我們的框架是與具體實體無關的，並在自動駕駛（AD）中實現，這裡傳統模擬的保證方法最為成熟。應用於兩個駕駛WM，較低的階梯顯示出一種逆轉：在視覺生成質量上排名較高的模型（L0）在行動跟隨（L1-L2）上排名較低，因此視覺保真度並不能預測閉環判決所依賴的行動穩健性。
